entries.name: Rhino (Rhinoceros 3D)

licence.name: commercial licence

engines.name: Brep and NURBS surface engine (trimmed surfaces, polysurfaces, extrusions)
engines.does: Stores solids and surfaces as bounded trimmed NURBS faces. Surface commands take curves or edges and give a surface or polysurface, with history on many commands.

engines.name: SubD engine
engines.does: Revolve and extrude can output a SubD object instead of a NURBS surface; Bevel and Crease work on SubD edges.

engines.name: Analysis mesh engine
engines.does: Builds hidden analysis meshes from the Polygon Mesh Options so that false-colour and reflection displays can be drawn on surfaces.

engines.name: openNURBS file layer
engines.does: Rhino reads and writes 3DM through McNeel openNURBS, per the features page; Rhino also has its own modelling kernel (Wikipedia kernel list names it as in-house).

capabilities.does: Fits one surface through two or more ordered profile curves. Style sets the knot structure (Loose, Normal, Straight sections, Tight, Uniform). Can close the loft, match start and end tangent to adjacent surfaces, or taper to a point.
capabilities.inputs: Two or more profile curves picked in order; optional start or end point; seam handling for closed curves (Flip, Automatic, Natural, SnapToKnots)
capabilities.outputs: One lofted surface; shape curves can be left alone, rebuilt to N control points or refitted within a tolerance

capabilities.does: Sweeps ordered cross-section curves along one rail. Frame style is Freeform, Roadlike (axis based) or Align with surface. Options: closed sweep, global shape blending for tapers, untrimmed miters, refit rail, rebuild or refit sections.
capabilities.inputs: One rail curve (ChainEdges allowed) and cross-sections in order; optional start or end point

capabilities.does: Sweeps cross-sections between two rails. The dialog can keep the first and last section, maintain height, refit rails, and match edge continuity (Position, Tangency, Curvature) when the rails are surface edges. Add Slash controls alignment between sections.
capabilities.inputs: Two rails with similar degree and structure; ordered cross-section curves

capabilities.does: Makes a transition surface between two surface, polysurface or extrusion edges. Continuity is set per end: Position (G0), Tangency (G1), Curvature (G2), G3 or G4. Sliders, bulge, and extra shape curves adjust the form; Edit reopens a history blend.
capabilities.outputs: A blend surface; Join avoids render cracks with the source faces

capabilities.does: Rounds polysurface edges with a tangent surface and can vary the radius along the edge by handles. Rail type is DistFromEdge, RollingBall or DistBetweenRails. Trim-and-join puts the fillet into the solid.
capabilities.inputs: Edges of a polysurface or extrusion; radius per handle; chain or face-edge selection
capabilities.outputs: Fillet surface, trimmed and joined to the faces (history only when TrimAndJoin is off)

capabilities.does: Constant-radius round between two surfaces. Radius has a slider with a range. Blend Type is Arc (G1 arcs), Deformable (degree 3 to 5, with Tangent and Bulge) or G2 Blend. Options Trim, Join, Extend.
capabilities.inputs: Two surfaces and the side of each to keep; radius
capabilities.outputs: Fillet surface plus trimmed inputs, optionally joined into a polysurface

capabilities.does: Round between two intersecting surfaces with a radius that changes along the edge. Handles carry radius values and can be added, copied, removed or linked. Radius can come from a curve or two points. Rail type matches FilletEdge.
capabilities.inputs: Two intersecting surfaces; radius handles; rail type
capabilities.outputs: Tangent fillet surface; TrimAndJoin on or off

capabilities.does: Makes a ruled bevel surface between two surfaces. The Distances option sets how far the chamfer edge lies from the intersection of the inputs. Extend, Trim and Split options handle unequal edge lengths and cut the inputs back.
capabilities.inputs: Two surfaces and the side of each to keep; two distances
capabilities.outputs: Chamfer surface and, if asked, trimmed or split inputs

capabilities.does: Moves an untrimmed surface edge to meet another surface edge or a curve with Position, Tangency or Curvature continuity. Can preserve the opposite end, average both surfaces, refine to tolerance, and set isocurve direction handling.
capabilities.inputs: Untrimmed edge to change, target edge or curve; tolerances in distance, degrees and percent of radius

capabilities.does: Builds one smooth surface from a grid of crossing curves in two directions. Edge and interior tolerances and an angle tolerance control the fit. Edges can be matched with Position, Tangency or Curvature continuity. History keeps it live.
capabilities.inputs: Curves in two directions, each crossing the other direction; edge, interior and angle tolerances

capabilities.does: Fits a surface to curves, edges, meshes or points. Controls: sample point spacing, surface U and V spans, stiffness, tangency adjust, automatic trim. An optional starting surface can be kept near, with preserve-edges.
capabilities.inputs: Curves, edges, meshes, points or point clouds; optional starting surface
capabilities.outputs: A fitted surface that may not touch every input exactly

capabilities.does: Joins closed polysurfaces or surfaces into one by trimming away shared volume. Needs closed objects with outward normals to judge inside and outside. Options: DeleteInput, MergeCoplanarFaces. Failures are marked with text dots.
capabilities.inputs: Two or more polysurfaces, surfaces or meshes
capabilities.outputs: One polysurface (mesh inputs give a mesh)

capabilities.does: Subtracts one set of closed objects from another. Pick the objects to cut, press Enter, then pick the cutters. DeleteCutters option. Rhino cannot make a solid that holds a fully enclosed void.
capabilities.inputs: Objects to keep and cutting objects

capabilities.does: Keeps only the volume where two sets of closed objects overlap. Supports DeleteInput and history.
capabilities.inputs: One or two sets of intersecting closed objects

capabilities.does: Splits objects along cutting objects into separate pieces for the shared and unshared parts. The cutters may be the same objects as the inputs. Boolean2Objects cycles union, differences and intersection by clicking.

Copies a surface or polysurface at a fixed distance, with Sharp or Round corners. Options: Solid (closed volume), Loose (same control structure), BothSides, ThroughPoint, Tolerance. Exact for planes, spheres, tori and open cylinders and cones; free-form is within tolerance.
capabilities.inputs: A surface or polysurface; distance with sign
capabilities.outputs: Offset surface or closed solid; history on

capabilities.does: Cuts curves and surfaces where cutting objects cross them and deletes the picked parts. A trimmed surface keeps its full underlying surface plus trim curves. View projection and apparent intersections matter for curves in non-plan views.
capabilities.inputs: Cutting objects, then the parts to remove
capabilities.outputs: Trimmed objects; Split plus delete is the alternative

capabilities.does: Spins a profile curve about an axis to a surface or SubD. Options: FullCircle, start angle, Deformable (degree 3 non-rational rebuild with PointCount), SegmentCount for SubD, SplitAtTangents, DeleteInput.
capabilities.inputs: Profile curve(s) and an axis of two points
capabilities.outputs: Exact rational NURBS surface, a deformable surface, or a SubD

capabilities.does: Pushes a curve along a straight direction into a surface, extrusion object or SubD. Options: Direction, BothSides, Solid (caps a closed planar profile), ToBoundary, SetBasePoint, DeleteInput.
capabilities.inputs: One curve and a distance or two-point direction
capabilities.outputs: Extrusion object (planar curve, perpendicular direction) or polysurface

capabilities.does: Rebuilds a curve or surface to a chosen point count and degree (curves up to 11). Options: delete input, preserve end tangents, make SubD friendly, match a master curve, retrim. Reports maximum deviation from the original.
capabilities.inputs: Curves, extrusions or surfaces; point count and degree (U and V for surfaces)
capabilities.outputs: A new object with clean structure

capabilities.does: Shows a reflected image on a surface so that ripples and kinks show up as warped reflections. Options: choose the image, blend with render colour, show edges and isocurves, mesh density. Can reveal faults that zebra stripes miss.
capabilities.outputs: A display only, no geometry change

capabilities.does: Colours a surface by curvature with a false-colour display. A separate Curvature command reports curvature at a picked point, and CurvatureGraph displays curvature graphs for curves, surfaces and SubDs.
Colours a surface by its draft angle with a false-colour display; DraftAnglePoint places a point where the draft angle breaks.
EdgeContinuity reports the distance, tangent difference and curvature difference between a pair of edges.
EdgeSrf makes a surface from two, three or four boundary curves. DevLoft makes a developable surface between two rails. ChangeDegree and ConvertToBeziers change the polynomial structure of an object.
capabilities.inputs: Two to four edge curves, or two rails

capabilities.does: Cap fills planar holes in an object with planar faces to make it closed; CreateSolid makes a closed polysurface from surfaces; Boss extrudes closed planar curves up to a boundary and joins them.
capabilities.inputs: Open polysurface or surfaces; closed planar curves for Boss

capabilities.does: Check reports errors in an object's data structure. Audit checks the whole model, Audit3dmFile checks a closed file, and CheckNewObjects can check objects as they arrive.
The RhinoCommon method Brep.CreateShell takes a Brep, a list of face indices to remove, a distance and a tolerance, and returns Breps; the page shows the signature only.
RhinoCommon lists Brep.CreateFromMesh to build a Brep from a mesh, and Brep.CreateCurvatureAnalysisMesh for a curvature-coloured mesh.
RhinoCommon is the .NET API. The Brep class exposes loft, sweep, pipe, boolean, fillet, blend, patch, offset and shell constructors plus validity and area or volume queries.
BlendSrf sets continuity at each end as Position (G0), Tangency (G1), Curvature (G2), G3 or G4. MatchSrf values: distance in model units, tangency in degrees, curvature in percent of radius.

QuadRemesh turns surfaces, meshes or SubDs into quad meshes. Options: Target Edge Length or Target Quad Count, Adaptive Size 0 to 100, Symmetry Axis, Guide Curves with Curve Influence, Detect Hard Edges, Convert to SubD with creases and corners.
capabilities.inputs: Surfaces, meshes or SubDs, optional guide curves

capabilities.does: Subdivision geometry tools such as SubDPlane, SubDSphere and Bridge sit beside NURBS, mesh and point-cloud tools; Revolve and Extrude can output SubD directly.
ShrinkWrap builds a watertight mesh around open or closed meshes, NURBS, SubD or point clouds, for 3D printing. Mesh tools import, create and edit polygon meshes, including scan data.
Native 3DM through openNURBS, USD export, glTF import and export; the features page links a full format list that was not read.

outcomes: exact surfaces and solids for device housings, tubes, caps and cassettes

rea.notes: Rhino is closed; the manual and RhinoCommon API are public, and the 3dm file code (openNURBS) is open. Several Rhino 8 help pages (FilletSrf, Shell, CurvatureGraph, CurvatureAnalysis) return an empty redirect shell and Zebra returned 403, so those functions are cited from the command list page or the chamfersrf page only. Import and export roles on the formats list were taken from the Wikipedia comparison table and are not verified.

entries.name: Autodesk Alias (Surface / AutoStudio)

licence.name: commercial licence (plan details not checked)

engines.name: NURBS surface and curve-on-surface engine
engines.does: Builds surfaces with exact continuity classes G0 to G3 and keeps trimmed surfaces with hidden trim curves that Untrim can restore.

engines.name: Construction history
engines.does: Many surface tools keep history (Create History, Auto Update, Query Edit) so a surface updates when its input curves change.

capabilities.does: Defines the join quality levels: G0 position, G1 tangent, G2 curvature, G3 rate of change of curvature, and G4 (blend curve tools only). G3 is offered in most tools that take continuity, but not Rail or Square. Tolerances come from Construction Options.

Surface Fillet builds a blend between two surface sets, auto-trimmed. Construction type: Radius, Arc (Chord), Existing or Build Theoretical. Section type: G0 Chamfer, G1 Circular or Tangent, G2 or G3 Curvature, Bias, Lead. Form Factor runs 0.1 to 2.
capabilities.inputs: Two G1-continuous surface sets (a third for multi-surface); size by chordal length, tangent length, tangent offset or centre radius
capabilities.outputs: Fillet surface; G2 needs degree 5, G3 degree 7

capabilities.does: Surface Fillet can vary its size at several points along a guide curve (parameter 0 to 1). Use Minimum Radius adjusts the form factor so the radius never falls below a limit.
capabilities.inputs: Fillet guide curve; size values at curve parameters

capabilities.does: Freeform Blend joins two contact lines (surface curves, free curves or both) with side continuity G0 to G3 set per side. Controls: Form Factor, Side Shape values, Proportional Crown, U degree, Single or Multiple surfaces, Bezier patches, flow control, modify range.
capabilities.inputs: Two contact lines; continuity per side
capabilities.outputs: One or several blend surfaces; G2 needs V degree 4 or 5, G3 needs 6 or 7

capabilities.does: Profile Blend shapes a transition by cross-section profile curves placed between primary surface boundaries. Side continuity G0 to G3 is set per side; Interior Edge Align, Single or Multiple surfaces and Bezier patches are available.
capabilities.inputs: Primary surface edges and any number of profile curves (blend curves, boundaries, free curves)

capabilities.does: Rail Surface sweeps generation curves along one or two rails. With two rails it works as a birail. A continuity table sets G0, G1, G2, implied tangent or curvature, or tangent angle per boundary. Transform Control: Rotate No Trim, Rotate & Trim, Non-Prop Scale, Scale.
capabilities.inputs: 1, 2 or more generation curves; two rail curves; rebuild flags

capabilities.does: Rail Surface with one rail offers Sweep Mode (Proportional, Spine, View, Parallel, Natural), Sweep Pivot (Off Curve, On Curve, Closest) and a fixed curve choice.

Align moves a curve or surface edge to a master curve or edge at G0 to G3. Options: Alignment Type (Edge, Project, U/V, Vector), Tangent Balance, scale factors, AutoScale G2 or G3, Blending over extra CV rows, Position Influence, Shrink to Fit, Continuity Check locator.
capabilities.inputs: Input edge, master edge or curve
capabilities.outputs: Reshaped input with the requested continuity

capabilities.does: Continuity is checked numerically (Curve Continuity, Surface Continuity tools) or by locators on tools. G2 deviation is computed as the radius difference over the radius sum. Curvature combs show join quality.
capabilities.outputs: Pass or fail locators and values

capabilities.does: Diagnostic Shade modes give visual surface-quality checks: Iso-Angle, Horizontal/Vertical, Isophotes and Light Tunnel. The page names the modes but does not describe each one.
A Curvature Comb control option on the fillet tool displays a comb plot across the surface; combs also show how smoothly curves connect at each continuity level.

Trim Surface trims or splits NURBS surfaces with projected curves, cross sections or intersecting surfaces. Method is Project or Intersect; Keep, Discard or Divide the picked regions. Limit Projection and Extend handle partial projection. Trimmed parts are hidden, not deleted.
capabilities.inputs: Target surfaces; curves-on-surface, cross sections or intersecting surfaces; vector for projection

capabilities.does: Extrude (a legacy tool) sweeps profile curves along a path curve. Style Tube keeps a constant angle to the path; Flat keeps the profile orientation. Create caps (Off, Cap Start, Cap Both) works for a single closed planar profile. Sharp polyline paths give mitred corners.
capabilities.inputs: Profile curve(s) and a path curve

capabilities.does: Skin builds a straight surface between two curves or edges, with optional crown and shape for higher-degree surfaces. Selecting more curves gives a blended skin through all of them.
capabilities.inputs: Two or more curves or edges

capabilities.does: Revolve sweeps curves around an axis or vector in Freeform mode. A second mode builds automotive side-glass surfaces with a Barrel or Helix construction.

Surface Offset places a copy of a surface at a chosen distance; a negative value flips the side. Offset modes: Automatic, CV Offset, Explicit, Original. Options include Both Sides, Create Trim (keeps trim data), Create Wall (closed geometry) and Create COS.

outcomes: Class A automotive and product surfaces

rea.notes: Closed program with a detailed public tool reference (option names and what each does). Scripting and file-format names in this entry come from general knowledge of the product, not from a page opened in this sweep, except where a capability cites a page. The Alias help states G3 is not offered in Rail and Square; one older page says G3 and G4 are blend-curve only (version difference).

entries.name: Plasticity

licence.name: commercial; Indie and Studio plans named in the manual (prices not checked)

engines.name: Parasolid kernel
engines.does: Siemens Parasolid is the solid and surface kernel under Plasticity, per the Wikipedia kernel list.

capabilities.does: Loft joins two or more curves or edges (shortcut L) with optional guides. Faces or regions give a solid. Options: Simplify, per-edge Continuity G0 to G2 (Tab cycles), Tension, Loop for a closed loft, limit points, Trim overlap on guide or profile side.
capabilities.inputs: Profiles (curves, edges, regions, faces, vertices) in flow order, optional guides

capabilities.does: Fillet (shortcut B) rounds or bevels edges by dragging a distance. Shapes: Conic, Chordal, G2 (curvature continuous), Full. Tension changes intensity; Y-Blend Attempt improves three-surface corners; tangent-edge toggle T.
Pressing V on a fillet adds a variable point so the distance changes along the edge.
capabilities.inputs: A fillet in progress; variable points

capabilities.does: The same command makes chamfers by a negative distance. Chamfer shape is Offset (default) or Apex, which reduces displacement of the chamfer border.
Bridge Surface blends between two sheets, separated or intersecting. Options: Width, Tension, Shape (G2 or Chamfer), Trim walls (Both, Short, Long, None), Sense 1 and 2. Key A adds a wall pair.

Patch fills closed curves or holes bounded by edges. Continuity is Planar, or G0, G1, G2 per edge. Also: Tolerance, Faces (Single, Minimal, Quality), guide curves, and trim methods Trim to hole or Trim to sheet.
capabilities.inputs: Closed curves or boundary edges; optional guide curves
capabilities.outputs: Patch sheet, or a sealed solid when all holes are patched

capabilities.does: XNurbs builds a surface bounded by three or more edges, including four-sided ones, with continuity G0, G1 or G2 to neighbours. Used to fill gaps and complex holes.

Boolean (shortcut Q) works on any mix of solids and sheets. Operations: Union, Difference, Intersect, Slice, Region. Keep Tools toggle; Target and Tool material options (Default, Empty, Inside, Outside). Failures show in red.
Difference removes the tool bodies from the target bodies (shortcut W in the Boolean tool).
Intersect makes a solid from the overlap of the bodies (Shift+E).
Hollow hollows a solid. Selecting a face leaves an open void; selecting the whole solid gives a closed hollow. Thickness by yellow handle, dialog value or key D; option Local.

Offset Face moves faces in or out by a distance. Angle Adjacent sets the angle to neighbours; Grow is Moving, Fixed or None; Dependant Offset matches a second face. Command index also lists Offset Curve, Edge and Face Loop.
Curves have four levels G0 to G3; surfaces three, G0 to G2. Curvature display and Measure Continuity help check joins; the page does not confirm zebra stripes are built in.
Measure Continuity tests whether two surface edges meet at G0, G1 or G2 (G3 not supported). Toggle Curvature shows curvature on surfaces and sketch objects.

Curve commands: Spline Curve and Control Point Curve draw curves, Bridge Curve joins curves, Split Curve At Point cuts one in two, Insert CV At Point adds a control vertex, Trim removes a part. Circle, arc, ellipse, polygon, spiral and rectangle variants also exist.
The command index lists Thicken and Thicken Face next to Hollow under Solid commands. The page was not opened for options.

outcomes: NURBS and solid models with controlled curvature continuity
bridges to Blender and Cinema 4D (named in the manual's Integration section)

rea.notes: Closed program with a public command manual. Platforms, formats and scripting were not read from a page, so those lists are empty. The manual notes G3 is not supported by Measure Continuity.

entries.name: Onshape

licence.name: commercial cloud service (plans not checked)

engines.name: Parasolid kernel
engines.does: Siemens Parasolid is the geometry kernel behind Onshape, per the Wikipedia kernel list.

capabilities.does: Loft joins profiles (sketch regions, faces, edges, points) into a solid, surface or thin solid. Start and end conditions: Normal, Tangent, Match tangent, Match curvature, with Magnitude. Guides carry their own continuity. Optional path, trim, vertex connections.
capabilities.inputs: Two or more profiles; optional guides or path; connections
capabilities.outputs: Solid, surface or thin; New, Add, Remove or Intersect

capabilities.does: Fillet rounds edges, or does a Full round across faces. Measure by Radius or Width. Cross-section Distance (circular), Conic (Rho) or Curvature (Magnitude 0 to 0.999). Options: tangent propagation, asymmetric, partial, edge overflow, smooth corners.
capabilities.inputs: Edges or faces; radius or width

capabilities.does: Variable fillet assigns separate values at selected vertices and extra points on an edge, with a smooth transition option between them.

Sweep moves a profile along a path to a solid, surface or thin solid. Profile control: None, Keep profile orientation, Lock profile faces, Lock profile direction. Twist by Turns, Angle or Pitch; Scale at the end; Opposite direction.
capabilities.inputs: Closed or open profile; path from sketch entities, curves or edges
capabilities.outputs: Solid, surface or thin; New, Add, Remove, Intersect

capabilities.does: Shell hollows a part to a constant wall thickness. Select faces to open, or tick Hollow to keep it closed. Opposite direction puts the wall outside the face.

Draft tilts faces for mould release. Neutral plane mode takes a plane and faces; parting line mode takes a pull direction and a parting edge (created with Split). Tangent propagation and Reapply fillets options.
capabilities.inputs: Neutral plane or parting line, faces, angle

capabilities.does: Thicken turns a sketch, face or surfaces into a solid. Mid plane uses one value; otherwise Thickness 1 and 2. Result is New, Add, Remove or Intersect with a merge scope. Keep tools retains the originals.

Fill builds a surface from a closed chain of boundary edges. Continuity per edge: Position (G0), Tangency (G1), Curvature (G2). Guides are points or curves, Sampled or Precise. Show isocurves with a Count. Closed result becomes a solid on Add.
capabilities.inputs: Closed edge chain; optional guide points or curves

outcomes: parametric parts and surfaces in the browser

rea.notes: Closed cloud service with a public help centre. Help pages for Boolean, Offset surface and Boundary surface returned only the help landing page, so they are not cited. Formats come from the Wikipedia comparison page. Platforms from the same page. Import and export roles on the formats list are not verified.

entries.name: Open CASCADE Technology (OCCT)

licence.name: LGPL-2.1 with an additional exception (commercial add-ons sold separately)

engines.name: Modeling algorithms (BRepPrimAPI, BRepOffsetAPI, BRepFilletAPI, BRepFeat, BRepAlgoAPI)
engines.does: C++ classes that build and modify B-rep shapes: primitives, sweeps, lofts, fillets, offsets, features, booleans.

engines.name: Data exchange and XDE
engines.does: Reads and writes STEP and IGES, mesh and scene formats, and assemblies with metadata.

engines.name: Visualization
engines.does: Interactive 3D views with selection, highlighting, hidden-line removal and materials.

capabilities.does: BRepPrimAPI classes make a box, wedge, cylinder, cone and sphere from dimensions, points or a frame; partial shapes take angles; MakeOneAxis is the base for rotational primitives.

BRepOffsetAPI_ThruSections lofts through wires added with AddWire; AddVertex gives a point at an end. Flags: isSolid, ruled, pres3d. Also SetSmoothing, SetContinuity, SetMaxDegree, SetParType, CheckCompatibility for twist and edge matching.

BRepOffsetAPI_MakePipeShell sweeps profiles along a spine wire. SetMode picks Frenet, discrete, fixed trihedron, fixed binormal, support surface or auxiliary spine. Add takes WithContact and WithCorrection; SetLaw scales; SetTransitionMode handles corners.
capabilities.outputs: Shell or solid (MakeSolid for closed profiles)

capabilities.does: BRepOffsetAPI_MakePipe sweeps a profile along a G1-smooth spine and keeps the profile to spine angle. GeomFill_Pipe makes circular constant-radius, constant-section or evolving-section pipes as BSpline surfaces.
capabilities.inputs: Spine wire or path curve and profile

capabilities.does: GeomFill_ConstrainedFilling fills a contour from three or four curves, with tangency constraints. BuildPlateSurface and MakeApprox build plate surfaces from curve and point constraints.

BRepFilletAPI_MakeFillet: Add(radius, edge) rounds an edge and the fillet runs along smooth continuations. Re-adding an edge replaces the earlier setting. BRepFilletAPI_MakeFillet2d rounds or chamfers vertices of planar faces.
Variable radius fillets use SetFilletShape(ChFi3d_Rational) and an Add overload that takes an array of 2D points giving the radius along the edge.
BRepFilletAPI_MakeChamfer: Add(dist, edge, face) or Add(d1, d2, edge, face) with the face next to the edge. The chamfer surfaces are ruled.
capabilities.inputs: Shape, edge, face, one or two distances

capabilities.does: BRepOffsetAPI_DraftAngle adds draft to planar, cylindrical and conical faces from a direction, an angle and a neutral plane.
capabilities.inputs: Faces, pull direction, angle, neutral plane

capabilities.does: BRepOffsetAPI_MakeOffsetShape offsets a shape by join (analytical continuation, arc join by default) or by the simple method that maps each surface to its offset surface.
BRepOffsetAPI_MakeThickSolid hollows a solid: the join method takes closing faces, an offset and a tolerance; the simple method makes a solid from a shell.
BRepFeat_MakePrism builds a prism feature from a profile by height, until a face, from-until, or through all; MakeDPrism adds a draft angle; MakeRevol revolves by angle or until a face.
BRepBuilderAPI_Sewing stitches faces into shells. Parameters: working tolerance, minimal tolerance, non-manifold mode; local sewing is supported.

BRepAlgoAPI_Defeaturing removes chosen faces by extending their neighbours; BOPAlgo_MakeConnected glues shapes through General Fuse; BRepFeat_SplitShape splits faces by wires or edges. The overview also lists Boolean operations.
capabilities.inputs: Shape, faces to remove, cutting wires or edges

capabilities.does: Reads and writes engineering formats such as STEP and IGES, mesh and scene formats, and XDE assemblies with names, colours and metadata.
HLRBRep_Algo gives exact projected visible and hidden edges for drawings; HLRBRep_PolyAlgo is faster and works on a polyhedral approximation. Projector classes define the view.

outcomes: B-rep solids and surfaces in code

entries.name: SolveSpace

licence.name: GPL (per the Wikipedia CAD list, which marks it open source)

engines.name: SolveSpace kernel
engines.does: Own geometry kernel per the Wikipedia kernel list; exact NURBS surfaces or triangle meshes for solid operations.

capabilities.does: Constraints: Distance/Diameter, Angle, Horizontal/Vertical, On Point/Curve/Plane, Equal Length/Radius/Angle, Length Ratio, Symmetric, Perpendicular, Parallel/Tangent, Lock Point. Over-constrained sketches turn red and list removable constraints.
Extrude makes a solid from a closed section on one or both sides. Lathe sweeps a full 360 degrees; Revolve sweeps to a chosen angle; Helix sweeps while translating, for threads.

Solid groups combine by union, difference or intersection; assemble keeps imported parts apart. Works on triangle meshes (fast) or exact NURBS surfaces (accurate but less robust, sensitive to chord tolerance).
Step Translating copies a group along a line; Step Rotating copies it around an axis. Link/Assemble imports another SolveSpace file as a positioned part.

Exports STEP for exact surfaces, STL and OBJ for meshes, SVG, EPS, PDF, DXF, HPGL and PNG, section views for cutting, CSV traces and simple G-code. Imports IDF board files and linked SolveSpace files.
capabilities.outputs: CAD, mesh, vector and cutting files

outcomes: 2D profiles for laser or waterjet cutting

rea.notes: The reference does not cover scripting. Licence version not read; the Wikipedia CAD list marks the project open source. A compact, readable example of a small NURBS CAD kernel.

capabilities.does: Script language of primitives (cube, sphere, cylinder, polyhedron, circle, square, polygon, text, surface) combined with union, difference and intersection.
linear_extrude(height, center, convexity, twist, slices) pushes a 2D shape up; rotate_extrude(angle, convexity) spins it about the Z axis. The 2021.01 cheat sheet lists no scale argument.
hull() wraps its children in a convex hull; minkowski(convexity) sums shapes; offset(r | delta, chamfer) grows or shrinks 2D outlines with round, sharp or chamfered corners.
projection(cut) flattens or slices a 3D object to a 2D shape; resize, scale, mirror, rotate, translate and multmatrix transform; color sets display colour.
import(file, convexity) reads DXF and SVG for 2D and STL, OFF, AMF and 3MF for 3D; export happens from the GUI or command line, not from a language function.
module and function definitions, include and use for libraries, for, intersection_for, if and let for control flow.

rea.notes: Cheat sheet is version 2021.01. The Wikipedia comparison page lists STL, DXF, OFF, AMF, 3MF, SVG formats. Manifold library lists OpenSCAD as a user (the Manifold README).

entries.name: CadQuery

capabilities.does: Workplane methods needing active 2D wires: extrude, twistExtrude, cutBlind, cutThruAll, hole, cboreHole, cskHole, revolve, sweep, loft, text.
Workplane.loft joins wires on stacked workplanes; Workplane.sweep follows a path; Workplane.revolve spins a profile.
Solid edits: shell, fillet, chamfer, split. Booleans: union, cut, intersect, combine. Primitives: box, sphere, cylinder, wedge.
Sketch class: face-based shapes (rect, circle, ellipse, slot, regularPolygon, polygon, hull, offset, fillet, chamfer) and edge-based (segment, arc, spline, close, assemble, constrain, solve).
Assembly add, constrain and solve with Constraint and Color objects.

Selectors pick faces, edges and vertices by position (NearestToPointSelector, BoxSelector), direction, size (Length, Area, Radius Nth), type, logic combinations (And, Sum, Subtract, Inverse) or string syntax.
importers.importStep and importDXF; exporters.export, Workplane.toSvg and exportSvg, and a DXF document class. STL, AMF and 3MF exporters are not on this page.

outcomes: scripted parametric parts and assemblies on Open CASCADE

rea.notes: Open CASCADE as the kernel is known from the project's own description but is not stated on the API page, so no engine is listed. A good checklist of what a code-driven CAD API exposes.
